message.content: During their meeting at "Central Perk" on Thursday morning, Yuriko shared feedback on the demo website. Specifically, she appreciated the color scheme, which reflected the gentle vibe of her studio. However, she suggested adding a section dedicated to community outreach programs, believing it would highlight her work effectively. Yuriko also proposed including details about the programs she offers and testimonials from participants, along with some photos from past events. Regarding these suggestions, Li Hua responded positively, indicating that they could indeed add a community outreach section to the website. He expressed enthusiasm about brainstorming some ideas for this purpose and emphasized his willingness to help implement Yuriko’s suggestions. Li Hua also mentioned that he would assist in designing the layout and presentation to ensure the section looked visually appealing and engaging.
